author: SpaceX
text: Falcon 9 is vertical at pad 40 in Florida ahead of today’s launch of the @SES_Satellites O3b mPOWER mission. The 87-minute window opens at 2:49 p.m. ET. Teams are keeping an eye on weather, which is currently 60% favorable for liftoff → https://spacex.com/launches/mpower-f
